questions.label: Ranked Wins
questions.prompt: Since 2018, which school has more wins over AP-ranked opponents, and how many?
questions.reveal: Ole Miss 12, Mississippi State 10 (through 2025). Latest: Ole Miss: 2025 vs. No. 13 Oklahoma 34–26, 2025 vs. No. 17 Tulane 41–10, 2025 vs. No. 2 Georgia 39–34; Mississippi State: 2022 vs. No. 17 Texas A&M 42–24, 2022 vs. No. 20 Ole Miss 24–22, 2025 vs. No. 12 Arizona State 24–20.

info.title: What counts as a ranked win?
info.text: A win over a team in the AP Top 25 the week of the game (bowls use the last regular-season poll), regular season and postseason, through 2025.

questions.label: Egg Bowl
questions.prompt: The 2013 Egg Bowl went to overtime: Mississippi State scored first, 17–10. How did Ole Miss's last chance end?
options: Bo Wallace fumbled; Mississippi State recovered in the end zone
An interception in the end zone
A turnover on downs at the 1
questions.reveal: Bo Wallace fumbled and Jamerson Love recovered in the end zone. Wallace had also thrown three first-half interceptions.
